timestamps.representative_optima: Multiple valid optimal schedules may differ on dates. Acceptance compares objective and proof, and validates all returned timestamps.

proof.project_makespan_minutes: Integer or null. Set only on complete_project schedules.
proof.makespan_by_scope_minutes: Mapping populated only for the reported complete_project, conditional_projection or unblocked_subset scope.
proof.lower_bound_minutes: Primary proof bound in minutes for the same schedule scope.
proof.optimality_gap_minutes: Primary absolute gap for the same scope.
proof.timestamp_source: primary, secondary or null. A secondary tie-break cannot change the primary proof.

supply.planned_placed_volume_m3: Declared physical plan as a rational string or null. Never inferred from allowance.
supply.productive_capacity_allowance_m3: Rational string for declared scheduling draw during productive minutes.
supply.restart_capacity_allowance_m3: Rational string for conservative scheduler draw during authorized restart.
supply.total_capacity_allowance_m3: Sum of productive and restart allowances. Conservative scheduler rate and daily limits count both.
supply.physical_day_allocation: Declared all-day plan for an unsplit single-day pour, or apportioned only where a declared constant placement profile reconciles to the declared plan. Unknown otherwise.
supply.material_cost_environment: Restart allowance has no effect on material quantities, cost, or environmental quantities.

dated_capacity.interval: local midnight to local midnight, including DST days
dated_capacity.timezone: Resource calendar timezone. Project calendar timezone for continuously held assets without their own calendar.

validation.internal: Rechecks serialized timestamps with shared calendar and capacity preparation.
validation.independent: Source-fixture oracles remain a separate acceptance gate.
